purpose: Matched three-surface reference and five-mirror-plus-grating VIS-NIR imaging spectrometer fabrication feasibility study

proposed_detector_and_slit.detector_type: 2D array; placeholder geometry, not a selected commercial detector
proposed_detector_and_slit.qualification: QE and usable SNR at 1100 nm require detector selection and radiometric analysis

proposed_acceptance.spectral_metric_definition: Worst over slit position and wavelength; finite slit, aberrations, diffraction and pixel integration included; flag multi-peaked profiles separately
proposed_acceptance.calibration_validation: Held-out spectral lines and slit positions; calibration cannot count as correcting optical blur
proposed_acceptance.geometric_survival_definition: All launched rays in denominator; independent of coating loss, diffraction efficiency and QE
proposed_acceptance.thermal_policy: No mechanical realignment with temperature; temperature-indexed wavelength calibration allowed and independently validated
proposed_acceptance.yield_reporting: Report binomial confidence interval; target applies jointly to implemented acceptance gates under explicit manufacturing distributions, not a certification
proposed_acceptance.packaging: Report full mechanical envelope; preserve compactness as a trade objective, not a 100 cm3 hard release gate

tolerancing_policy.perturbations: Physical component poses about mounting datums, surface errors, groove errors, slit and detector; not normalized search genes
tolerancing_policy.compensators: Select bounded physically accessible adjustments before Monte Carlo; one alignment per assembled instrument across all fields/wavelengths
tolerancing_policy.fabrication_tolerances: To be derived from sensitivity, compensated Monte Carlo and vendor capability; no arbitrary micrometre or arcsecond release limits

release_blockers: Finite-width slit and pixel-integrated line-spread model
Detector selection, QE, radiometric throughput and SNR requirements
Spatial resolution and raw/calibrated smile and keystone requirements
Substrates, mounting datums, housing, thermal model and alignment access
Surface figure/slope/roughness specifications linked to vendor metrology
Validated tolerance budget and assembly test plan

industry_context.published_comparator: VIS-NIR 350-1000 nm, 25 um slit, typical 1.64 nm FWHM
industry_context.interpretation: Commercial scale reference only; not a matched 10 mm slit imaging spectrometer and not evidence our targets are achieved

rationale: 100 nm/mm times 0.025 mm image width is 2.5 nm; actual slit-width magnification must be measured. A 10 um pixel is about 1 nm sampling at target dispersion. Targets leave nominal-to-assembly headroom and require validation.
